The "'''jumper quarries'''" were [[Marble/Legends|marble]] quarries in the [[High Ontis]] region of [[Ralltiir/Legends|Ralltiir]]. By the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]], the quarries and nearby mines were tapped out and the region's numerous tunnels was used as a base by criminal organizations and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. One Rebel cell formed a tunnel network that reached from the jump quarries to the [[Grallia Spaceport]]'s [[Docking Slip 120-54]], 40 [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] away.<ref name="CatCW" />
